function: Learns the passive STAR-RIS reflection and transmission amplitudes and phase shifts (RMIX multi-agent DRL) for energy-efficient beamforming; active zero-forcing precoding comes from fractional programming (p. 3, 7).
system: Downlink multi-cell MISO CoMP: 2 BSs with 10 antennas, 2 STAR-RISs of 50 elements (coupled phase-shift), 13 users; carrier frequency not stated (p. 4, 11).
method: Value-based risk-sensitive multi-agent deep RL (RMIX, QMIX with CVaR, centralized training, decentralized execution), trained online with epsilon-greedy exploration; hybrid with model-based fractional programming for reward (p. 7-8).
data_channel: Custom simulator: Rician BS-RIS and RIS-user links, Rayleigh direct links, path-loss exponent, users wandering in 3 m circles; no 3GPP model, dataset, or measurement (p. 5, 11).
test_conditions: Trained and evaluated online in one simulated setting; sweeps over elements, antennas, users, rate target, RIS position; no generalization test, left to future work (p. 7, 12-13).
baselines: Learned: DQN and QMIX (Fig. 5), RMIX-trained Baseline1 (fixed amplitudes) and Baseline2 (group mode-switching), MAPPO for continuous phases; non-learned: random STAR-RIS coefficients (p. 11-12).
metrics: Average energy efficiency (rate over total power, Eq. 14), average data rate, EE versus training episode (p. 6, 12-13).
complexity: Training complexity of RMIX O(K*T*2S*Qs*T0) (p. 9); active beamforming O(2TN^3.5) via interior point (p. 11); Algorithm 2 converges in at most 5 iterations (p. 11).
openness: none; no code or data link, only software versions named (p. 11).
q1_support: p. 5: "as Rician fading" and "follows Rayleigh fading". Custom fading simulator with a path-loss exponent; no 3GPP model, COST 2100, DeepMIMO, or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 7: "generalize solutions in unfamiliar environments, such as increasing the number of users or STAR-RIS elements" is left to future meta-learning or transfer. Figs. 7-11 (p. 12-13) are sweeps, with no model tested outside its training setting.
q3_support: p. 12: "the obtained EE of RMIX is slightly better than others" (QMIX and DQN, Fig. 5); p. 12: "outperforms the baseline and random cases" (Fig. 8 legend: Random STAR-RIS coefficients).
q4_support: p. 9: "the computational complexity in training the RMIX algorithm is approximated by" O(K*T*2S*Qs*T0); p. 11: "the computational complexity of Algorithm 2 can be approximated by" O(2TN^3.5).
q5_support: p. 11: "All simulation results are provided with PyTorch 1.10 on the Python 3.6 platform and Matlab 2018b." No code or data link, and no public channel dataset: channels are simulated.
notes: Hybrid method: RMIX learns the passive STAR-RIS coefficients while active ZF beamforming is model-based (fractional programming), so the learned function is area 3. q3 rests on Fig. 5 (EE versus episode, RMIX slightly above DQN and QMIX, p. 12); Baseline1 and Baseline2 are RMIX variants and are not counted as learned baselines. Frequency band not stated.
